verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair thing to ask of a SaaS AI-assistant platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of any official SDK. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the MCP and 'write its own integration against the tool's API' items describe Lindy consuming other tools, not developers building against Lindy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
